title: Approved public page loads
steps: Open the configured URL without following unapproved hosts.
expected: Successful HTTP response. This establishes reachability only.

title: Primary documented journey
steps: Sign in as owner-a and create a note with a valid title and body.
Reload and confirm the note persists; edit it and confirm the change persists.
expected: The documented create and edit outcome is achieved and survives reload.

title: User and organization boundaries
steps: As owner-a create a note. As org-b-admin request that note by its id.
As org-a-member (no share) request the same note by its id.
expected: Both non-owners are denied server-side; no note body is returned.

title: Responsive and keyboard journey
steps: Check the notes list and editor at narrow and wide viewports.
Complete note creation using only the keyboard and inspect focus and labels.
expected: Content stays usable; controls have meaningful labels and visible focus.

title: Authentication and session lifecycle
steps: Verify login succeeds with valid credentials and is rejected with invalid ones.
Log out, then replay the prior session cookie against a notes endpoint.
expected: Only valid identities gain access; the logged-out session cannot read notes.

title: Validation and saved-state integrity
steps: Submit an empty title, a 121-character title, and a duplicate note.
Reload and verify no partial or contradictory record was stored.
expected: Valid data persists; rejected input leaves no partial record.

title: Error and recovery states
steps: Inspect empty, loading, and error states through approved non-destructive methods.
Submit the same note twice quickly and check for duplication.
expected: Users get actionable feedback; retry does not duplicate important actions.

title: Sensitive information exposure
steps: Inspect UI and API responses for secrets or data beyond the actor's permissions.
Review the organization members response for other users' emails or roles.
expected: Secrets and unauthorized personal information are not exposed.

title: Integration outcomes
steps: Inventory integrations and review applicability. Admin Notes has none in this example.
If a real copy has integrations, verify success, rejection, and resulting state against approved sandboxes.
expected: Integration and application states agree with documented business rules.

title: Share and revoke inside an organization
steps: As owner-a share a note with org-a-member and confirm the member can read it.
Revoke the share and confirm the member is denied on the next request.
expected: Access follows the share state immediately in both directions.

title: Member invitation and role assignment
steps: As org-a-admin invite a new user and set role to member.
Accept the invite and verify the resulting role from the invited user's session.
Attempt to accept the invite a second time or with a tampered role value.
expected: Role matches what the admin set; replay or tampering does not escalate.
